draft_required_truths.draft_statement: An in-process queue can be implemented in <300 LOC supporting backoff scheduling, concurrency caps, and per-tenant isolation without external dependencies.
Bun's crypto subtle/HMAC primitives provide timing-safe HMAC-SHA256; replay-window check is a stateless timestamp delta (no nonce store required).
A post-response microtask deferral primitive is available in Hono — already proven by the request-journal write path (RT-6.3).
A per-webhook circuit breaker (closed -> open -> half-open) can be implemented in ~80 LOC of state-machine logic.
The existing src/features/url-validator.ts can be reused (or shared-modulised) for outbound webhook URL validation without breaking proxy upstream validation.
SnapshotHolder.get() returns a stable reference; closures capturing the current snapshot survive subsequent swaps so in-flight retries continue against the snapshot that scheduled them.
The industry-standard outbound webhook contract (HMAC, idempotency-id, replay window, retry curve) is documentable and replicable from public sources (Stripe, GitHub, Slack, Svix specs).

gap_checklist_compliance.notes: Core data path: inbound request -> match -> response served -> microtask-deferred enqueue -> backoff sleep -> URL validate -> sign -> HTTP delivery -> classify outcome -> retry/DLQ/circuit. Boundaries: response->queue (in-process), queue->HTTP-out (network). Integration tests required for: happy path (T5,T7), retry-then-success (T3), DLQ exhaustion (B3,O4), circuit-trip (O3), hot-reload mid-curve (T9), admin replay (O4).

HMAC attack surface (S1,S3): tests required for timing-safe compare, replay-window boundary (5min), malformed/missing timestamp rejection, signature-with-wrong-secret rejection, IPv4-mapped-IPv6 in URL validator equivalence.

Resource exhaustion guarded by O1 (per-tenant queue depth cap with drop-oldest), O3 (circuit breaker prevents wedge on dead receiver), T8 (per-attempt timeout). All inbound triggers go through normal mock-matching auth flow; webhooks themselves are outbound.

External dependency = the webhook receiver. T8 (configurable timeout), O3 (circuit breaker), retries classified transient vs permanent (T3). No caching layer (deliveries are not idempotent reads). Failure of one webhook isolated by per-webhook circuit (O3).

Webhook config validated by Zod at config load (extends existing schema.ts pattern). Outbound URL re-validated each attempt (S2) since URLs may template per-request. Response-body assertion (U2) validated against optional schema. Inline-secret rejection (S3) at config load.

Bun JS runtime is single-threaded for user code, so queue enqueue/dequeue is implicitly atomic. Cross-tenant queues are independent (per-tenant isolation). Snapshot hot-reload concurrency handled by SnapshotHolder ref-stability (T9, DRT-6). Concurrent delivery cap per tenant configurable via in-process queue's concurrency setting.
